name: Celestine: One to Eleven
source:
Join Celestine and Secta on a mysterious quest with many twists and turns in this otome JRPG! Make decisions that will decide their ending. Explore a town in a pixel game format! Meet another male love interest in a cameo! 

Celestine woke up in a world in which one of her past lives lived. On Secta’s route, he promises to help Celestine study and learn some magic so that she can find a way home.

[From [url=https://bleukazoo.itch.io/celestine-one-to-eleven-demo]itch.io[/url]]
